payload.claim: If two acceptance criteria share the same witness and both have a mutant outside `source`/test paths but each reaches a different qualifying `subject`, `kept` holds two distinct (witness, subject) tuples for that one witness, so `len(kept_by_subject)` overcounts: the note would read e.g. '2 witness(es) a declared subject kept judged' when only one witness is actually involved. This only affects the informational count in the summary text, not any pass/fail/skip decision, so it changes nothing an operator acts on.
